provenance_categories.manufacturer-published: Direct transcription from a manufacturer table or catalog record.
provenance_categories.manufacturer-digitized: Engineering digitization from a manufacturer curve; verify against the source figure for controlled work.
provenance_categories.engineering-extrapolation: Explicit extension beyond the 300 Hz manufacturer curve limit.
provenance_categories.calculated: Derived from geometry, load equilibrium, matrix assembly, eigenanalysis, or complex frequency response.

limitations: The manufacturer dynamic-property figures end at 300 Hz. Predictions at 600, 1200, 1400, and 2000 Hz require an explicit extrapolation choice.
The archived NASA test paper is application evidence, not a property database for the modeled geometry.
Product availability and catalog ratings are subject to change; verify the current manufacturer product page before procurement.
Temperature dependence, aging, vacuum, contamination, amplitude dependence, mounting-plate flexibility, and capture-hardware contact are not characterized by the Version 1 model.
